summary: Three explicit 124-frame arm-control videos were compiled at 1280x720 from language-specific camera-pixel trajectories and the reviewed high-quality robot anchor.
evidence: outputs/minimax-h3-action-controls/20260810T134000Z-explicit-trajectories-v2/manifest.json records three decoded outputs and explicit left/right wrist coordinates for every frame.
The minimum pairwise two-wrist trajectory RMS separation is 81.1222 camera pixels, above the 40-pixel gate.
Contact sheets visibly separate insertion, chest-level handover, and eye-level inspection trajectories.
lessons: Explicit per-frame trajectories make the intended action contrast inspectable before expensive H3 inference.
Intermediate controls must be visibly labelled and kept separate from final generated results.
limitations: The controls use rigid 2D arm pieces and are not final model outputs, physical trajectories, or contact simulation.
